text:
katie: Hey team — finalizing the release notes + internal announcement for tomorrow's deploy (02:00 UTC). Draft below; please drop edits. We're planning to pin the public API to v2.3.1 for the immediate rollout.

--- draft ---
Heads-up: We're rolling out model-serving improvements and latency optimizations. No user-facing API changes. Expect a brief warmup window. Pinned version: v2.3.1. If ops detect regressions, we'll rollback to v2.3.0.
--- end draft ---

katie: Question — should we enable canary or keep it off for this rollout? I lean off for predictable behavior.

matt: +1 keep canary off. Pin to v2.3.1. Add a 1-line note about customer-facing SLAs unchanged.

oliver: Oncall OK for 02:00 UTC. Rollback criteria: >5% error rate or latency P95 spike >200ms sustained for 3 minutes. If hit, run `/deploybot abort 2025-06-15-v2.3.1` and revert traffic to v2.3.0. I'll be on watch for first 30m.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2025-06-15-v2.3.1 -> production at 2025-06-15T02:00:00Z. canary:false, pinned:true, job_id:deploy-9834

anita: For internal announce copy: call out affected services and list owner contacts. Audience: #eng, #support, #customer-success. Maybe add a short 'what to expect' bullet.

jen: I'll add a line on Dedicated customers: they'll be contacted separately if pinning is required on their fleet. + include rollback contact @oliver and @matt.

katie: Great — locking copy at 23:30 UTC tonight. Final note added, sending draft internal blast to #eng, #support, #customer-success. Thanks all :tada:
